• Use the filters (language, functionality level and age range) to narrow down the collection of the public visual stories. The visual stories provided are generic and not personalised.
  • Click on the story you want to view to see the content.
  • Click 'Print' if you want to print the story.
  • Click 'Close' to close the story.

We strongly recommend that you complete the PASS4Autism online course before you start viewing the stories. The course will familiarise you with issues such as what a visual story is, how to create a visual story, what the functionality level in autism is, and the role of age in autism.

Do not hesitate to join the PASS4Autism Support Network if you would like to join the community of therapists and parents, participate in discussions about visual stories and share your own stories!
